mainEntity.name: What is included in a wedding makeup package in Prague with Nikol Pavlova?

acceptedAnswer.text: The wedding makeup package includes a bridal trial session before the wedding day, full wedding-day makeup application, false lashes, and a personal touch-up kit so your look stays flawless from ceremony through reception.

mainEntity.name: How far in advance should I book a wedding makeup artist in Prague?

acceptedAnswer.text: For weddings in Prague, booking 6–12 months in advance is recommended, especially for the peak season from May to September. Bridal trials are typically scheduled 4–8 weeks before the wedding day.

mainEntity.name: Does Nikol Pavlova travel for destination weddings in Prague and Czech Republic?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Nikol Pavlova is based in Prague but is available for destination weddings throughout the Czech Republic and across Europe. Travel fees may apply depending on the location.

mainEntity.name: Is Nikol Pavlova an English-speaking wedding makeup artist in Prague?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Nikol provides all bridal consultations and makeup services in fluent English and Czech, making her an ideal choice for international couples, expats and destination weddings in Prague.

mainEntity.name: How much does bridal makeup cost in Prague?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bridal makeup pricing depends on the service scope, location and date. Nikol Pavlova offers personalised quotes upon request – contact her via phone, email or Instagram with your wedding details.

mainEntity.name: Can Nikol Pavlova do makeup for the entire bridal party?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. In addition to the bride, Nikol can provide professional makeup for bridesmaids, the mother of the bride, and the full bridal party. Group packages are available upon request.

mainEntity.name: What wedding makeup styles does Nikol Pavlova specialise in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nikol specialises in a wide range of bridal looks – from soft, romantic glows and natural nude aesthetics to glamorous evening bridal looks and bold, creative styles. Each look is tailored to the bride's features, dress and wedding theme.
